# Complete401-tuple historical chain review

All465 actual raw responses personally reviewed:64 spelling choices and401 final bodies. Synthetic281 and historical natural120 remain separate. Normalization/meaning/usable organization/uncertainty are distinct; no overlap or validator proxy establishes success. Two retained-criterion failures include one explicit-emphasis omission with correct final value; cancellation framing and incomplete natural predicate stay uncertain. Original v1 judgment and second-review provenance retained. No source fallback or hidden rejected outputs.
